Remark
[Trace of the $K$-tensor] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0316 ↗ thm:chow-ii-minimizing-harnack-two-tensor-evolution 1. ch15:15.26\group Minimizing Harnack Tensor

The tensor $K$ is skew in its last two indices and satisfies \[ g^{vt}K_{avtu}=Z_{ua}. \] Moreover $S_{mntu}K_{avut}K_{bvmn}$ is nonnegative as a symmetric two-tensor.
Proof

\sketch Contract the definition of $K$, use $\nabla _vR_{rsvu}=P_{urs}$, and use the divergence formula for $P$ in the proof of Lemma 4. Positivity follows by writing the positive operator $S$ as a sum of squares on two-forms.

□
